title: 動一動
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L159 動. Latest origin/main now contains L158 樹, so dependencies L157 and L158 are already merged and no provisional learned characters are required. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only; use 裡 not 裏. Do not add unlearned display characters such as 直, 葉, 搖, 園, 被, 跟, 狼, 豬, or 磚. Sentence 3 image may depict a generic storybook wolf-and-pig-house situation, but the display sentence must remain exactly approved and must not add unlearned characters. Avoid any branded or copyrighted adaptation style. Images must use L058 style anchors and contain no text, numbers, signs, letters, zhuyin, labels, logos, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 prefix/suffix from exact fragments, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.

approvedSentences.scene: An adult encourages a child who has been sitting to stand up and move around. Show simple stretching or moving action, with no exercise text, signs, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, logos, or watermarks.

Strong wind blows through a tree, making the tree visibly move. Show wind motion clearly through branches and surroundings, with no text, symbols, signs, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, logos, or watermarks.
